elections.name: Arkadelphia School District special election
elections.text: Voters approved raising the school tax 3 mills, to 47.65, and up to $37.17 million in bonds for a new high school — For 1,126, Against 393. The election drew 16.4% of the 9,221 registered voters living in the district. Those bonds will be repaid with $74.5 million through 2056.

elections.name: Preferential primary runoff
elections.text: 339 ballots were cast in Clark County, about 3% of registered voters, per the state’s official results.

note: Special elections and runoffs usually draw far fewer voters than November general elections; these figures are shown for scale, not as a judgment. The school election figures are as reported by the newspaper; an official clerk results page for it has not been found yet.
